title: Group action of Hochschild-Serre algebra and categorical reconstruction
summary: We study the action of the Serre functor of smooth proper dg categories at their Hochschild-Serre algebra, and the invariant sub-aglebra of the Serre functor. As applications, we prove some theorems of categorical Torelli. Namely, let $\Ku(\X)$ be the Kuznetsov component of degree $d$ smooth hypersurface in weighted projective space $\mathbb{P}(a_0, a_1, \cdots, a_n)$, where the common maximal divisor $\gcd(d, \sum^{n}_{i=0}a_{i})=1$.
